25857.d: Stormguard Citadel Dig Site is a dig site that players can visit in the Archaeology skill.
25857.loc: Temple of Ikov and the sky above Gielinor

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop.
• Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly
• Master archaeologist's outfit teleport function.
• Ardougne lodestone then running north-east.
• Seer's Village lodestone, then running south.
• Manor farm teleport then running north.
• North Ardougne Teleport from the Lunar spellbook, then running north.
• Fishing Guild Teleport from the Lunar spellbook, then running east.
• Combat bracelet teleport '4' to the Ranging Guild, then running south-east.
• Skills necklace teleport '1' to the Fishing Guild, then running east.
• Skills necklace teleport '6' to the Farming Guild, then running north-east.
• Spirit tree teleport 'M' to Manor Farm, then running north.
• Master quest cape teleport '7' to the Legends' Guild, then running north-west.
• Legends' cape teleport, then running north-west.
• Ardougne teleport, then running north.
• Fairy ring BLR, then running north-west.

25946.d: The Stronghold of Player Safety is a dungeon under the Misthalin Training Centre of Excellence.

gt.heading: Entrance
gt.text:
At ground level, there are three entrances.
• There is a jail entrance behind the Training Centre, which allows the player to access the jail. This is marked by the dungeon icon on the map and is the only entrance usable at first.
• The main door into the Training Centre, which is locked, preventing players from opening it from the outside, until they talk to the Guard in the jail and go through the entire conversation about reporting rule-breakers. Once inside, going down the stairs leads players down to the same jail level.
• A crevice immediately north of the centre, a shortcut into the dungeon that can only be used after climbing the rope from inside the dungeon at least once.

The world map would often show players at a wrong level of the dungeon. Therefore, it is advisable to enlarge the minimap and reference this article for locations.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Stronghold of Player Safety'
